mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( email, password, name, nickname, phone, post_code, parcel_address, street_address, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at, role, status ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{postCode}, #{parcelAddress} ,#{streetAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{role}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name = #{user.name}, nickname = #{user.nickname}, phone = #{user.phone}, post_code = #{user.postCode}, parcel_address = #{user.parcelAddress}, street_address = #{user.streetAddress}, detail_address = #{user.detailAddress} WHERE user_id = #{user_id}
UPDATE user SET profile_url = #{profile_url} WHERE user_id = #{user_id}
